posts.title: Machinists > Tailors
posts.description: Software engineers are turning into AI Engineers? No, we are turning into software machinists. Replacing handmade software with (increasingly) cheap, plentiful, machine-made software. Unlike tailors who handcraft each item, machinists build tooling and inspect samples and then produce in large numbers. Mid 2025 tab completion was a toy.
